name: Sunway Construction Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Sunway Construction Group Berhad 对两家间接全资子公司 Sunway Machineries Services Sdn Bhd 和 Sunway Visioneering Sdn Bhd 启动成员自愿清盘，这两家公司已停止业务并处于休眠状态。其余公告主要为股息、附加上市和季度业绩等常规事项，未披露新的业务扩张、合约或业务线变动。
overview_en: In 2026, Sunway Construction Group Berhad commenced member's voluntary winding up of its indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries Sunway Machineries Services Sdn Bhd and Sunway Visioneering Sdn Bhd, both of which have ceased business operations and are dormant. The remaining announcements were mainly routine matters such as dividends, additional listings and quarterly results, with no new business expansion, contracts or business line changes disclosed.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年对两家已停止业务并处于休眠状态的间接全资子公司启动成员自愿清盘。
segments.note_en: This year, member's voluntary winding up was commenced for two indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries that have ceased business operations and are dormant.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 对间接全资子公司 Sunway Machineries Services Sdn Bhd 和 Sunway Visioneering Sdn Bhd 启动成员自愿清盘，两家公司已停止业务并处于休眠状态。
actions.text_en: Commenced member's voluntary winding up of indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries Sunway Machineries Services Sdn Bhd and Sunway Visioneering Sdn Bhd, both of which have ceased business operations and are dormant.
